purpose: Acceptance surface for B1 primary semantic materiality only. B2 composition and actual-diff closure are intentionally out of scope.

scenarios.title: Organization boundary implies tenant isolation and object authorization
scenarios.project_brief: A SaaS hosts many customer organizations in shared infrastructure.
scenarios.request: Add an authenticated endpoint that lets an organization download its audit log while preventing members of any other organization from reading those entries.

scenarios.title: Ordinary organization listing does not imply cross-tenant isolation
scenarios.project_brief: A public directory displays organization names and descriptions.
scenarios.request: Add a public page that lists organization names alphabetically. It does not expose private organization data or authenticated objects.

scenarios.title: Large live row transformation is migration and capacity material
scenarios.project_brief: A production relational database serves live traffic continuously.
scenarios.request: Transform roughly 80 million existing rows to populate a new derived field while normal writes continue; design execution to bound database load, locking and rollout risk.

scenarios.title: Small local fixture generation stays outside production migration governance
scenarios.project_brief: A developer-only fixture database is recreated locally and never promoted to production.
scenarios.request: Generate two hundred synthetic rows for a local test fixture before running unit tests.

scenarios.title: Production image build semantics route container engineering without Docker keyword
scenarios.project_brief: A service is packaged and promoted to production as a versioned release artifact.
scenarios.request: During the production image build, install a dependency directly from the default branch of a remote Git repository, then publish and promote the resulting image as reproducible.

scenarios.title: Explicit README-only Docker example does not route container engineering
scenarios.project_brief: Repository documentation includes developer examples; no delivery change is requested.
scenarios.request: Add a README sentence showing the existing docker run command. Do not change images, dependencies, CI, build or release configuration.

scenarios.title: Caller-selected backend destination is a server-side trust boundary
scenarios.project_brief: A public service backend can reach both internet and private infrastructure.
scenarios.request: Create a public preview API where the caller supplies a remote resource location and the backend HTTP client retrieves that location before returning metadata.

scenarios.title: Browser-only navigation is not server-side destination trust
scenarios.project_brief: A static browser UI has no backend proxy or server-side URL fetching capability.
scenarios.request: Render a user-provided website link as a normal browser anchor so the browser navigates directly. The application server must never fetch the target.

scenarios.title: Clinical outcome decision is regulated and authority-dependent
scenarios.project_brief: A general software product has no documented clinical policy, jurisdiction, regulatory classification or qualified clinical authority.
scenarios.request: Add logic that decides whether a patient should receive urgent clinical treatment from reported symptoms and measurements. No approved clinical decision policy has been supplied.

scenarios.title: Ordinary commercial recommendation remains non-regulated
scenarios.project_brief: A warehouse application recommends packaging from product dimensions and weight.
scenarios.request: Recommend a carton size from item dimensions and shipping weight to reduce unused space.
